About Homa
At Homa, we’re building the games a billion people will play. Games that become part of players’ lives for years. A company where every person grows faster than they thought possible. A company where talent, data and AI turn ideas into hits at a pace no one else can match. And a company that wins with speed, excellence and candor.
To get there, we partner with studios and develop our own games, powered by Homa Lab, our proprietary platform. Homa Lab gives developers the market intelligence, data tools and AI-built game tech to find product–market fit fast and turn mass-market games into lasting hits. Every launch feeds data back into the next, so each turn of the loop is faster, smarter and more likely to win. So far, that’s 80+ titles, 2 billion+ downloads, and All in Hole in the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
Our teams are small, talent-dense and light on hierarchy: 160+ people from 30+ nationalities, from the world’s best studios and tech companies. AI runs through everything we do. We’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare and Spotify.
For an ambitious, curious, humble, and focused person, Homa is a place to learn, make an impact, and grow their career faster than anywhere else. That’s our promise.
The opportunity
As our first Economy Designer, you’ll own how its economy works: what players earn, what things cost, and what we sell. Every decision you make shows up in retention and revenue within weeks.
You’ll report to our Chief Product Officer and work with product, design, live ops, data and the studio team behind the game. You start on Harvest King, then take what you build to the rest of our RPG portfolio. You don’t need a games background. You need sharp economic thinking, ownership, and the drive to prove every change with data.
Your responsibilities

• Own. Run the economy of a live game end to end: currencies, rewards, sinks, pricing and offers.
• Diagnose. Find what really holds players back, and model it, before touching any lever.
• Balance. Get the mix of ads and in-app purchases right, so revenue grows without hurting retention.
• Experiment. Turn hypotheses into A/B tests, read the results, and keep only what works.
• Build with AI. Create AI tools that track economy health, flag problems and suggest the next tests.
• Scale. Turn what works on Harvest King into a method for every RPG title we launch.
• Shape. Drive the game’s roadmap with product and design, backed by your models and data.
Requirements

• Ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
• Proactive. You don’t wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
• Pragmatism. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
• Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain something complex in a few sentences.
• AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You’ve used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
• Hungry and motivated. You’re ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else, and do the best work of your career.
For this role, you’ll also bring

• Experience owning pricing, revenue, monetisation or an economy, in games, marketplaces, travel, fintech or similar.
• A shipped change you can measure: the number before, the number after, and your own part.
• Systems thinking: sources and sinks, supply and demand, and the constraint that limits the rest.
• Hands-on modelling, with SQL and Python or similar tools.
• Experience designing and reading A/B tests.
• Curiosity about free-to-play games and how they make money.
Bonus points if you have:

• Experience designing or running a game economy, live ops or monetisation.
• A background in economics, statistics or another quantitative field.

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Our Culture
At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

• Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow - we stay grounded in a clear view of ourselves.
• Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
• Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
• Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.
